name: How can I get rid of a sewage smell coming from my drains?

mainEntity.name: How can I get rid of a sewage smell coming from my drains?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sewage or sewer gas smell from your drains typically indicates a problem with your plumbing system. The most common causes include a dry P-trap (the U-shaped pipe under sinks), a clogged or improperly vented drain, or a crack in a drain pipe. The P-trap is designed to hold water and block sewer gases. If it dries out, gases can escape. Pouring water down unused drains can replenish dry P-traps. If the problem persists after this simple step, further investigation by a plumber is recommended to check for more serious issues like vent blockages or pipe damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sewage smell from drains often means a dry P-trap or a plumbing vent issue. Pour water down drains first; if it persists, call a plumber.
